inputImages.role: Failed v3 draft used as an edit target for structural anatomy/expression repair, not an approved appearance reference

ownerRequest: redo, following discussion that v3 had become frail, stretched and vacant; maintain towering alien anatomy and cold commanding anger
prompt:
Edit the supplied Butcher concept into a substantially redesigned v4. The source is a FAILED anatomy/characterisation draft: do not preserve its frailty, drooping hands, thin neck, pinched head or vacant face. Preserve only the underlying living pearl/obsidian material family, dark cult palette, full-body concept-sheet presentation and role text. This must be a decisive structural repair, not a small muscle adjustment.

OWNER'S BRIEF: towering and inhuman, long proportions, MASSIVE HANDS, visibly transformed anatomy. Battle-scarred GENERAL and WAR PRIEST, with anger expressed through COLD COMMAND and absolute control. He belongs to an ascended dark astral cult and stays at camp forging weapons/gear.

MAIN READ: an immense alien commander whose stillness carries crushing physical power. HEIGHT WITH WEIGHT. Replace the thin scholar silhouette with a deep, dense torso, wide powerful shoulders and back, thick sinewy upper arms, enormous heavy forearms, a solid narrow waist and strong load-bearing thighs/calves. Maintain elongated ALIEN proportions at about eight heads tall. Strong inward taper from shoulder to waist; no swollen belly, no human bodybuilder six-pack. Do not shorten him into a stocky dwarf or turn him into a conventional purple muscular human. Widen the torso and shoulder structure dramatically; increase the depth of chest and pelvis. His transformed rib architecture grows as three substantial oblique arches under continuous nacre skin, not exposed skeletal ribs. Long anatomy must have enough volume to support this commanding mass.

HANDS: broad immensely thick palms, heavy knuckles, powerful compact finger segments with visibly articulated pads. They look capable of crushing a forge billet and precise craftsmanship. Remove long spidery claw fingers. One hand is held low with fingers slowly curling, the other rests lightly on the waist fastening, both fully visible and clearly enormous. Arms extend naturally toward the lower thigh, not down to the shins. Wrist tendons and grown black obsidian reinforcement show controlled strength; flesh remains biologically alive. Five fingers per hand, short blunt dark nails. Two intact arms/two legs, no extra limbs or chosen amputation.

FACE: redesign the entire head to communicate authority. Broaden the cranium and lower jaw, shorten the long fragile neck into a powerful pillar which is still slightly inhumanly elongated. Remove the dangling cheek spikes and needle chin. Invent a broad, strong alien facial structure of soft living nacre and dense underlying bone. Two small lateral eyes under a weighty expressive brow; slight brow compression, lower lids tense, gaze sharply focused on the viewer. Mouth shut firmly with subtle asymmetric tension. He looks intelligent, experienced and murderously displeased while maintaining perfect control. He is not vacant, mournful, serene, smiling or roaring. No protruding human nose or ears. One old healed scar draws the brow into a distinctive asymmetric shape; no fresh wounds. Skin folds and translucency must make this a living face, NOT a skull, mask, metallic robot head, generic bald human or recognisable film/game alien. No new headgear.
No forehead eye, transparent brain, crown, halo, dreads or beard; those features belong to the separately locked leader.

POSE AND CLOTHING: a grounded square stance with strong feet, level shoulders, chest held with authority and chin slightly lowered. Slight three-quarter view, subtly low camera for presence, no action lunge. Redrape the black ritual cloth over the new broad body: a heavy officer's shoulder mantle passes diagonally over one collarbone and falls in a controlled vertical fold behind the shoulder, with the exposed sternum and most arms visible. Structured black waist cloth has three substantial ceremonial panels ending below the knees, showing the load-bearing leg anatomy. A few pieces of polished volcanic glass grow into the body at the forearms, outer hips and shins; restrained old-gold repairs and ONE small broken cult seal. No giant pauldrons, priest stole strips, knight armour suit, boots, excessive decoration, skull trophies or a hammer. Military authority comes from bearing and precise ceremonial clothing. Hands embody his forging role.

MATERIAL: living nacre skin in medium-value smoked amethyst/pearl with deep black-violet undertones and muted warm antique-gold scars. Keep luminous reflection but no glow. Broad skin surfaces must be smooth and biological with selective healed battle damage; no metallic marbling, no sickly pallor, reptile scales or pustules. Obsidian and black cloth are genuinely dark yet clearly lit. Restrained thin black mist follows the forearms and settles at feet. No neon, starfield, bright eyes, fire, giant FX or workshop.

COMPOSITION: main full figure dominates left 70%, updated matching face portrait upper right and broad powerful hand study lower right. All three views must match the same redesigned anatomy. Keep hands and feet fully in frame. Neutral warm grey backdrop, soft clear light, polished painterly science-fantasy character concept rather than photo or miniature. Text only "BUTCHER" and "WEAPONS / GEAR FORGING". This is ONE coherent new candidate. Priority order: imposing body mass and silhouette, intelligent controlled anger, massively powerful hands, living alien identity, then restrained regalia detail.
inspection: Viewed generated image: shoulders, chest, neck and limbs visibly broadened; pelvis and legs support greater weight; forearms carry greater volume and hands have thicker palms/fingers; one hand curls at the waist. Face is broader and brow more focused while preserving a strong resemblance to the v3 facial design. Original long jaw projections are reduced; fingertips remain dark and nail-like. The body now has a muscular commanding silhouette, though the result retains humanoid muscle landmarks and the facial redesign is less extensive than requested. Black cloth, nacre/obsidian/gold materials and restrained haze retained. Three concept views agree at this scale; sprite-scale readability and animation untested. Owner appearance approval remains pending.
injuryStatus: No specific Sovereign injury or amputation selected.
scope: One bounded Butcher image edit only. No leader/approved Glutton/other Pal changes, PixelLab, sprite conversion, animation, gameplay, code/build/Unity work, commits or pushes.
